import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int N = 1 << 20;
    static final int M = 21;
    static int n;
    static int[] f = new int[N];
    static int[] g = new int[N];
    static int[][] p = new int[M][M];
    static int[][] idx = new int[2][N];
    static int[] rev;
    static int[] matched; // unused
    static int[][] adj = new int[M][M];

    static int fpow(int x, int y) {
        int ret = 1;
        while (y != 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) ret = (int)((1L * ret * x) % MOD);
            x = (int)((1L * x * x) % MOD);
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    // next permutation in lexicographic order (returns false if already last)
    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] a) {
        int i = a.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && a[i] >= a[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = a.length - 1;
        while (a[j] <= a[i]) j--;
        int tmp = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = tmp;
        Arrays.sort(a, i + 1, a.length);
        return true;
    }

    static void work(int[] f, ArrayList<Integer> l, ArrayList<Integer> r, ArrayList<Integer> subgraph, int[] idxArray) {
        // build edges: all pairs (x in l, y in r)
        ArrayList<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int x : l) {
            for (int y : r) {
                edges.add(new int[]{x, y});
            }
        }
        int edgeCount = edges.size();
        int[] leftArr = new int[l.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < l.size(); i++) leftArr[i] = l.get(i);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << edgeCount); ++mask) {
            int rate = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < edgeCount; ++i) {
                int x = edges.get(i)[0];
                int y = edges.get(i)[1];
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    rate = (int)((1L * rate * p[x][y]) % MOD);
                    adj[x][y] = 1;
                } else {
                    rate = (int)((1L * rate * (1 - p[x][y] + MOD)) % MOD);
                    adj[x][y] = 0;
                }
            }
            // ensure rate positive
            rate = (rate + MOD) % MOD;

            int newmask = 0;
            for (int gr : subgraph) {
                // build indices (right vertices) corresponding to bits of gr
                ArrayList<Integer> indicesList = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if ((gr & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        indicesList.add(i + n);
                    }
                }
                // convert to int[] for permutation
                int[] indices = new int[indicesList.size()];
                for (int j = 0; j < indicesList.size(); j++) indices[j] = indicesList.get(j);
                Arrays.sort(indices);
                boolean flag = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int j = 0; j < leftArr.length; ++j) {
                        if (adj[leftArr[j]][indices[j]] == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        flag = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(indices));
                if (flag) {
                    newmask |= (1 << idxArray[gr]);
                }
            }
            f[newmask] = (f[newmask] + rate) % MOD;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int inv100 = fpow(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int prob = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j + n] = (int)((1L * prob * inv100) % MOD);
            }
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(p[0][1]);
            return;
        }

        int m1 = n / 2;
        int m2 = n - m1;
        int cnt = 0;
        int cnt2 = 0;
        ArrayList<Integer> sub1 = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer> sub2 = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            int bits = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            if (bits == m1) {
                idx[0][mask] = cnt++;
                sub1.add(mask);
            }
            if (bits == m2) {
                idx[1][mask] = cnt2++;
                sub2.add(mask);
            }
        }

        rev = new int[1 << cnt2];
        for (int i = 0; i < sub2.size(); ++i) {
            int mask = sub2.get(i);
            for (int bigmask = 0; bigmask < (1 << cnt2); ++bigmask) {
                if ((bigmask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    rev[bigmask] |= (1 << idx[0][((1 << n) - 1) - mask]);
                }
            }
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> l1 = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer> l2 = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer> r = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < m1; ++i) l1.add(i);
        for (int i = m1; i < n; ++i) l2.add(i);
        for (int i = n; i < n + n; ++i) r.add(i);

        work(f, l1, r, sub1, idx[0]);
        work(g, l2, r, sub2, idx[1]);

        // SOS DP on f
        for (int i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << cnt); ++mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    f[mask] = (f[mask] + f[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << cnt2); ++mask) {
            int w = (1 - f[(1 << cnt) - 1 - rev[mask]] + MOD) % MOD;
            ans = (ans + (long) w * g[mask]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
